notes.title: Version 1.2.0
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24679035/fb2aae985ad9c22731ce640ab20e6c1781072775.jpgHello everyone! Here is our second major update!

What is new in version 1.2.0:
- Free camera mode. Yes we have finally upgraded camera so you can control it with mouse/gamepad as you like (inversion option available in settings menu).
- One more nasty bug fixed (caused game crash if jumping on two enemies at one time). Perhaps it was the main reason of crashes during final boss fight.
- Now game has full controller/big picture support (you can change graphics settings inside the game).
- Mouse sensitivity now automatically adjusting your system settings.
- Vibration should work for all gamepads.
- Several issues fixed (colliders and shadows here and there).

We are really appreciate your feedback, it helps us to make Scrap Garden better and better! Please let us know if you face some other issues!
Enjoy the game! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hello folks! Here is Scrap Garden new update! 

What is new in version 1.0.2:
- You can now change camera angle by pressing shift or trigger (you should not hold it any more).
- Steam achievements fixed (now all of them should work properly).
- Fixed A LOT of places there C4NNY was able to fell our of the level (couple of them left with surprises for you to find). 
- We have made winter dynamite puzzle little bit easier and now red/green/blue TNT being thrown in the water appears again.
- Worm boss appearing out of the arena bug fixed.
- Fixed visual issues with water in jungle level.
- Interface controls. Now you can go back from pause menu with ecs.
- Bug with game frozen in winter level can-scene fixed.
- Some mistakes in FR localization fixed.
- Problem with "PULL" phrase localization fixed
- Hermit's fireplace now was back to earth and not levitating any more )))

We are listening all your bug reports and trying to solve most urgent issues. The next update with new bunch of fixes should arrive next week.
Enjoy the game! ːsteamhappyː
